items.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025
items.q: hearing all the stuff Pharoah Sanders and Albert Ayler were doing

ctx.x: I’m sure you do. And you know the whole way that the overtone series works through the horn and it’s not a linear instrument, and then listening to Coltrane with that knowledge was like oh my God, that’s what he’s doing, and hearing all the stuff Pharoah Sanders and Albert Ayler were doing and all that stuff. Like I started understanding it from the inside out and not just having it be this sort of mind-blowing thing that I didn’t – that was just impressions. I was understanding it. And the same thing happened…
